summary: Golden Heaven Group Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of two previously disclosed private placement transactions on April 23, 2026. The company issued 15,000,000 Class A ordinary shares for gross proceeds of approximately $18 million, plus additional shares upon cashless exercise of warrants. No specific price per share, premium, or board recommendation is provided. This is a routine capital raising disclosure, not a special situation event. No strategic review, tender offer, or activist campaign is involved. The filing serves to update the market on the completion of the placements.
